reviewScope: Internal functional and numerical review, not independent human expert, official curriculum, physical-device/touch/FPS, certified gravimetric method or printer certification. Known salt/insoluble-particle references; selected solution density 1 g/mL with suspended mass additional. Selected particle retention and held carrier fraction, ideal mixed-pore rinse at constant retained carrier, no particle washout, adsorption, channeling or evolving filter geometry. Nonvolatile salt totals during drying span liquid/solid phases without solubility allocation. No heating power, temperature, drying-rate, NTU, unknown-water composition or drinking-safety inference. Residue mg/L uses original processed volume; retained salt and passed particles mean these are operational residues, not certified TSS/TDS. Reference balances have no measurement uncertainty or instrument-resolution model; floating-point tare subtraction may round extremely small gains while inventory remains positive. Apparatus tares excluded from material conservation. Polygonal nominal volumes; selected particle bulk 2.5 g/mL and salt drawing envelope 1 g/mL are not empirical density calibration. Magnified particles, thin dish layer and vapour cues are illustrative, not counts or measured film thickness. Guide clamps unsupported tiny positive increments below 1e-12 to zero; exponential underflow permitted only below binary64 representation.
